fsm_states_link.name: ErrorReset
fsm_states_link.description: Entered after reset or a link error; transmit/receive activity stopped and reset; remains ~6.4 us then moves to ErrorWait.

fsm_states_link.name: ErrorWait
fsm_states_link.description: Waits ~12.8 us looking for receive activity; a disconnect/parity/escape error returns to ErrorReset, otherwise moves to Ready.

fsm_states_link.name: Ready
fsm_states_link.description: Link ready to start; waits until enabled (Start or AutoStart), then moves to Started.

fsm_states_link.name: Started
fsm_states_link.description: Transmitter enabled, sending NULLs; on receiving a NULL moves to Connecting; timeout returns to ErrorReset.

fsm_states_link.name: Connecting
fsm_states_link.description: Transmitter sends FCTs as well as NULLs; on receiving an FCT moves to Run; timeout returns to ErrorReset.

fsm_states_link.name: Run
fsm_states_link.description: Fully operational: NULLs, FCTs, Time-Codes, data characters, EOP/EEP flow with credit-based flow control; an error returns to ErrorReset.

fsm_hints.trigger: Reset / link error -> ErrorReset -> ErrorWait -> Ready. Enable (Start/AutoStart) drives Ready -> Started; receiving a NULL drives Started -> Connecting; receiving an FCT drives Connecting -> Run.
fsm_hints.rule: Data characters flow only in Run and only while credit > 0 (granted by received FCTs); NULLs keep an idle link active; both ends run the same state machine and synchronize by NULL/FCT exchange.
fsm_hints.abort: A disconnect / parity / escape / credit error in any active state returns the link to ErrorReset to re-run the handshake.

anti_deadlock_rule: Credit-based flow control bounds outstanding N-Chars to the receive buffer (max 56), so a receiver cannot be overrun; wormhole routing plus EOP/EEP termination and the ErrorReset recovery prevent a blocked or errored packet from stalling the link indefinitely.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up / reset the link enters ErrorReset, waits the reset and error-wait times (ErrorWait), becomes Ready, and — once enabled — sends NULLs (Started) then FCTs (Connecting) until it reaches Run.

default_ready_state_recommendation.idle: Send NULL characters to keep the link active and confirm the connection between data.
default_ready_state_recommendation.credit: Grant FCTs (each worth eight N-Chars) before the far end may send data characters.

configurations.description: A node connected to a SpaceWire port of a routing switch.

configurations.name: Router-to-router link
configurations.description: Two routing switches connected to grow the network.

configurations.name: AutoStart vs Start
configurations.description: AutoStart starts the link when activity is detected; Start starts it under host control.

timing_dependency_rule: No data character flows until the link reaches Run (NULLs exchanged in Started, FCTs exchanged in Connecting). Credit (FCT) must be granted before N-Chars are sent. The reset (~6.4 us) and error-wait/timeout (~12.8 us) intervals and the disconnect timeout (~850 ns) bound the handshake and error detection.
